Class ClassPathTransform.Result.Entry

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.aot.bytecode.ClassPathTransform.Result.Entry
Enclosing class:
ClassPathTransform.Result
@Internal public static final class ClassPathTransform.Result.Entry extends Object
What the steps did to one class path entry, a jar or a directory. Each step that ran over the entry counts every class of it once, as rewritten, unchanged or fallen back; a step that did not run over it, such as the strip step on an entry not named for it, counts nothing.
Since:
3.2.0

    • nestFallbacks

      public int nestFallbacks()
      The nests that desugaring planned and then wrote as they were, because a class of the nest failed or verified worse. Each has a line in notes(), and its sites count under nestFallback in sitesLeft(). Micronaut Runner reports it in its transforms.txt.
      Returns:
      the number of nest fallbacks

    • sitesLeft

      public Map<String,Integer> sitesLeft()
      The lambda call sites that desugaring left as invokedynamic, by reason, in a fixed order of the reasons, without the reasons that have none. The reasons are altMetafactory, shadowedOrUncertain, multiRelease, signedJar, nest, superCall, ownerAccess, callerSensitive, unresolvedType, nameTaken, java8Interface, serialVersionUid, interfaceInit, shape and nestFallback; they are for display, and a release may add one.
      Returns:
      the sites left, by reason
